manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling: a = -g. A second ball is released from rest at that exact moment to show they fall together.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side. Velocity and acceleration vectors update as time progresses through the apex.
manifest.instructions: Press Play to watch the motion, or use the scrubber to inspect instants around the top.
